literal_meaning: কিল দিয়ে কাঁঠাল পাকানো (nailing a jackfruit to ripen it)
figurative_meaning_en: Attempting to make the impossible possible
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজটা করা যেন কিলিয়ে কাঁঠাল পাকানো।
তার চেষ্টা সম্পূর্ণ ব্যর্থ, ঠিক কিলিয়ে কাঁঠাল পাকানোর মতো।
example_sentences_in_english: This task is like trying to ripen a jackfruit by nailing it.
His efforts are completely futile, just like nailing a jackfruit to make it ripen.
note: The idiom draws from traditional Bengali agricultural practices involving jackfruit, highlighting absurd attempts at fruit ripening.
